overview.short: Arnala Fort is built on a small island off the port town of Arnala, located around 13 km (8 miles) north of Vasai, Maharashtra, India.
overview.description: Arnala Fort is built on a small island off the port town of Arnala, located around 13 km (8 miles) north of Vasai, Maharashtra, India. Being an island fort, it is also called Jaldurg or Janjire-Arnala. The Marathas who built the present fort called it Janjire Arnala. The Vaitarna River in North Konkan meets the sea near this fort, allowing it to overlook the entire bay.

topPlaces.name: Vasai
topPlaces.description: Vasai (Konkani and Marathi pronunciation: [ʋəsəi]; Portuguese: Baçaim; British English: Bassein; formerly and alternatively Marathi; Bajipur) is a historical place and city located in the Palghar district; it was partitioned out of the Thane district in August 2014. It also forms a part of the Vasai-Virar twin cities in the Konkan division, Maharashtra, India, and comes under the police jurisdiction of the Mira-Bhayander, Vasai-Virar Police Commissionerate.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Arnala Fort?
faq.a: The best time to visit Arnala Fort is Oct – Mar. Summers are 26–40°C and winters are 12–28°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Arnala Fort?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Arnala Fort / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Kalyan Junction (Mumbai) (49 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Arnala Fort?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Arnala Fort at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Arnala Fort?
faq.a: Stays in Arnala Fort start from ₹900 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Arnala Fort?
faq.a: The top attractions are Kopharad, Holy Spirit Church, Nandakhal, Datiware, Dativare fort, Battle of Vasai.
